- We need a training schedule that covers both product owners and SREs (two half-day sessions each).
- DocuSign milestone schedule: we need the signed MAP + SOW no later than 2026-09-02 to hit our fiscal training windows.

On Thu, Aug 19, 2026 at 9:12 AM Caroline Zhang <caroline.zhang@nexahealth.com> wrote:
> Thanks Jordan & Vanessa — great call this morning. Attached is our initial mutual action plan PDF (Nexa_MAP_v1.xlsx)...

Caroline — great writeup and thanks for the clear asks. I've attached our response spreadsheet (Redwood_RESPONSE_MAP_v1.xlsx) with a proposed operational cadence that minimizes customer impact while hitting your training deadlines. High level proposal:

1) Pilot / Canary (Wave A) — scoped to 5% of traffic, selected tenant segment:
   - Canary window: 2026-09-08 00:00 UTC to 2026-09-14 23:59 UTC
   - Daily canary verification window: 02:00–06:00 PT (low-volume window for automated smoke tests + manual verification)
   - Rollback ready: full rollback available within 90 minutes; we propose a hard rollback cutover window 02:00–04:00 PT on days 2 and 5 for safety drills.

2) Training & Enablement:
   - Two SRE sessions (90 minutes each) during pilot week (2026-09-09 & 2026-09-11, 03:00–04:30 PT) — will include runbook walkthrough and live failover drill.
   - Two PO/business sessions (2 hours each) the week before full rollout (2026-09-20 & 2026-09-21).

3) Full rollout (Wave B): staged ramp to 100% over 48 hours starting 2026-09-22 02:00 PT.

Operational notes & asks:
- We will need NexaHealth to provision a short-lived canary key and a test tenant for the pilot by 2026-08-26.
- Please confirm your preferred SLAs for canary alerts (P0/P1 routing) so we can wire auto-escalation.

Attachment: Redwood_RESPONSE_MAP_v1.xlsx (timeline + migration checklist + training calendar).

Will follow up with Priyom on the autoscaling/rollback runbook.

—Jordan
Jordan Blake
Senior Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Caroline Zhang <caroline.zhang@nexahealth.com>
Date: 2026-08-19T16:02:00-07:00

Thanks for the quick turnaround, Jordan. A couple of clarifications from the operations-side:

- Migration blackout window: we will enforce a 2-hour blackout for non-essential schema/config changes within the canary verification window (02:00–04:00 PT), to reduce noisy changes during validation.
- Training windows: please confirm attendee lists so we can prepare role-specific labs. We will run a dry-run of the failover during the first SRE session.
- SLA: for the pilot we recommend P0 alerts go to Nexa on-call and P1 to both Nexa + Redwood on-call. We will codify this in the MAP.

Can we get a single consolidated MAP with these items and an agreed signoff column for both teams? Caroline — if you can mark the internal owners on your copy, Jordan and I will produce the final locked PDF.

—Vanessa
Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Customer Ops, Redwood Inference
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>

Date: 2026-08-20T10:21:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Draft MAP + close timeline (post-signature)

Looping in a short ops checklist and runbook extract (ops_runbook_canary.md). Notes:

- Autoscaling policy: during pilot, we will cap autoscaler to +30% baseline for the canary tenant and use conservative CPU thresholds (70% scale-out). This prevents noisy spikes from expanding the canary inadvertently.
- Rollback plan: snapshot + traffic-shift rollback (we automate traffic reweighting via our routing layer). Estimate full rollback time: 60–90 minutes in tests; include a manual kill switch if automated reweighting fails.
- Observability: we will provide token-level latency histograms and prefix-KV cache hit rates for the canary dashboards.

Attached: ops_runbook_canary.md (excerpt). I will expand the runbook into the REDWOOD ops repo once we lock the dates.

—Priyom
Priyom Das
Principal SRE, Redwood Inference
